text:
kai: Quick sync  we want to announce next Friday. Need changelog PR + docs anchors for CTAs and a short canary window. Can eng + docs land by Wed EOD?
morgan: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4988  changelog file at docs/changes/2026-06-18.md. Suggested canary: Fri 09:30-10:30 PT.
tara: I can add anchors and a small 'Try Dedicated' snippet. What exact anchor text do you want marketing to link to?
kai: Keep it tight: 'Model fallback' -> #model-fallback and 'Dedicated trial' -> #dedicated-trial. Also need a short sample webhook JSON for growth.
morgan: We'll call out fallback to smaller model variant under heavy load. Ops: @deploy-bot please reserve the canary slot and create an rc tag.
deploy-bot: Canary reserved: 2026-06-18T09:30:00-07:00 to 2026-06-18T10:30:00-07:00. Tag: rc/2026-06-18-announce. :white_check_mark:
felix: Growth will wire the form to /docs/dedicated/trial and tag leads with "dedicated-interest". Need the final docs URL to test.
tara: Docs PR created and includes anchors and webhook snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1108. I added sample webhook payload and contact email.
kai: Timeline: docs + changelog merged by Wed 20:00 UTC, canary Fri 09:30-10:30 PT, public post Fri 11:00 PT, webinar Mon 17:00 UTC. Deck due Wed 16:00. Everyone OK?
morgan: Fine from eng. I'll monitor canary and merge changelog if green. If problems we revert and push a short webinar-only announcement.

# merge note for eng:
```
# land changelog commit
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git cherry-pick 2a7d9f4
git push origin main
```
kai: Thanks all  I'll draft the blog with those exact anchor links and schedule partner pre-announce 30m before the public post. If any timing changes ping here."
